name: DaikyoNishikawa Corporation
summary: DaikyoNishikawa Corporation develops, manufactures, and sells automotive parts and synthetic plastic products in Japan. The company offers instrument panels, bumpers, radiator grilles and shroud panels; instrument and decoration panels, rear consoles, and indicators; and engine covers, oil strainers, and intake manifolds. It also provides housing-related plastic parts comprising bath unit parts, as well as gas pipes and iron-core stair mats. In addition, the company engages in the ownership, leasing, and management of movable and immovable property; collecting, transporting, and treating industrial waste; non-life insurance agency business and business related to life insurance solicitation;…
